name: Kurahashi Yukimi
source:
Working as a designer at Shirosawa Games, she has also gained a following as a streamer, which began out of her love for games.
A huge fan of [url=/c156948]Shinjo[/url]’s debut work, White Crash, she moved to Tokyo and practically beat down the doors at Shirosawa Games to get a job there. She looks up to Shinjo and co-founder [url=/c157621]Takazawa[/url] like older brothers.
Her Tohoku accent occasionally slips out during streams, which adds to her charm and draws in viewers.

[From in-game profile]
